```{r}
# Load necessary packages 
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
# Create function to compute NDVI
ndvi_fun <- function(nir, red){
  (nir - red) / (nir + red)
}
```

```{r}
# Load in first veg scene from June 12, 2018
landsat_20180612 <- rast(here("data", "veg-data", "landsat_20180612.tif"))
```

```{r}
# Update names of layers to match spectral bands
names(landsat_20180612) <- c("blue", "green", "red", "NIR", "SWIR1", "SWIR2")
```

```{r}
# Use lapp() function to pass NDVI function onto layers 
ndvi_20180612 <- lapp(landsat_20180612[[c(4, 3)]], fun = ndvi_fun)
```

```{r}
# Plot NDVI 
tm_shape(ndvi_20180612) +
  tm_raster(col.legend  = tm_legend("NDVI")) +
  tm_layout(legend.outside.position = "right")
```
